characters.design_en: Royal naval officer; dark swept hair, intact narrow gold crown, white-gold plate with unbroken crown badge, purple mantle, ordinary steel sword. Keep the original undead head and limb proportions.
characters.design_zh: 王室海军军官；深色侧扫发型、完整窄金冠、带完整王冠徽的白金甲、紫披风、普通钢剑。沿用原亡灵图头身与四肢比例。
characters.pose_en: Controlled pride; upright stance, one hand on sword pommel. No soul-fire, exposed bone or wreck damage.
characters.pose_zh: 克制的骄傲；挺拔，一手扶剑柄。不出现冥火、裸骨或沉船损伤。

additional_visual_variant.notes: Current undead concept reference; original u8_prince.png remains identity anchor. Front face and side skeletal jaw need continuity check.

characters.design_en: Age twenty; family resemblance through dark hair and brow shape. Ivory gown with muted gold edging, narrow red regency sash, simple intact crown, repaired wooden boat.
characters.design_zh: 二十岁；深发与眉形体现家族相似。象牙白长袍、暗金边、细红摄政绶带、完整简冠、修过的木船。
characters.pose_en: Composed adult sovereign, attentive and upright; formal court dress, not battle armour.
characters.pose_zh: 成年女王，沉着专注，站姿端正；正式宫廷服，不用战甲。

additional_visual_variant.notes: Adult living queen, working age twenty; check crown, sash and orthographic continuity.

characters.design_en: Tall floating silhouette; intact layered maritime funerary vestments in midnight charcoal, ivory and muted bronze. Faceless hood, translucent cyan-green hems, old oar and single soulfire lantern. No halo or visible anatomy that confirms his nature.
characters.design_zh: 高瘦悬浮剪影；完整层叠海葬祭服，深炭蓝、象牙白与暗铜。兜帽内无可辨认面孔，青绿半透明袍尾，旧桨与一盏冥火灯。不设神环或能确认身份的裸露形体。
characters.pose_en: Still and dignified; spectral weightlessness, restrained gestures. Never confirm his species.
characters.pose_zh: 静穆庄严，具有亡魂失重感，动作克制；不确认其种族。

characters.design_en: Broad, ageing face with family brow, silver-black beard, sober white and gold court robe, dark purple lining, royal signet. Full crown for formal portraits.
characters.design_zh: 宽厚而衰老的脸，家族眉形，银黑短须，克制的白金宫廷袍与深紫内衬，王室印玺。正式肖像佩完整王冠。
characters.pose_en: Authority worn down by responsibility; seated or standing over documents. No villain coding.
characters.pose_zh: 责任压出的疲惫威仪；可坐于案前或站立。不使用反派化符号。

characters.design_en: Coastal noble dress, soft cream and marine blue-grey, modest gold clasp with a wave motif. Living figure only.
characters.design_zh: 沿海贵族服饰，柔和米白与海灰蓝，带波浪纹的简洁金扣。只设计生前形象。
characters.pose_en: Warm attention and practical judgement; no spectral version.
characters.pose_zh: 温和专注，有务实判断。不做幽灵版本。

characters.design_en: Wide sturdy silhouette, enclosed naval helm, scratched insignia, worn shield, restrained turquoise in visor slit.
characters.design_zh: 宽厚稳固剪影、封闭海军头盔、磨损纹章、旧盾牌；面罩缝内少量青绿光。
characters.pose_en: Professional, grounded, careful with equipment; no ornate horns.
characters.pose_zh: 专业、沉稳，爱惜装备；不使用夸张骨角。

characters.design_en: Compact silhouette, patched surgeon apron over old naval clothes, instrument roll, gloves; small seams and subtle soulfire, not gore.
characters.design_zh: 紧凑剪影，旧军服外穿补丁军医围裙、器械卷、手套；细小缝线与少量冥火，不做血腥效果。
characters.pose_en: Busy, amused and competent; hands engaged with tools.
characters.pose_zh: 忙碌、风趣、专业；双手操持工具。

characters.design_en: Thin lich silhouette, scholarly hood, layered faded cloth, slate and a few floating manuscript fragments, teal soul-light.
characters.design_zh: 瘦长巫妖剪影、学者兜帽、层叠褪色布料、石板及少数漂浮残页、青绿魂光。
characters.pose_en: Exacting scholar rather than battle sorcerer. Keep silhouette distinct from the Ferryman.
characters.pose_zh: 严谨学者而非战斗术士；剪影必须与渡魂人区分。

characters.design_en: Small lively young undead sailor, oversized brass bugle, frayed crown pennant, simple naval tunic, boots.
characters.design_zh: 活泼年轻亡灵水手，小巧体态，略大的铜号、破王冠军旗、简洁海军衣与靴。
characters.pose_en: Impish posture, exaggerated movement rather than grotesque face.
characters.pose_zh: 俏皮姿势，靠夸张动作而非怪诞面部表现。

characters.design_en: Fur-edged merchant noble coat, navy and warm brown, ledger and customs seal, neat moustache or beard.
characters.design_zh: 毛边商贸贵族外衣，海蓝与暖棕，账簿、税印，整洁胡须。
characters.pose_en: Sociable, polished, easy smile; not a caricature of greed.
characters.pose_zh: 善交际、讲究、自然微笑；避免贪婪 caricature。

characters.design_en: Structured practical gown in deep ochre and olive, warehouse keys, wax tablet.
characters.design_zh: 深赭黄及橄榄色实用贵族服，仓库钥匙、蜡板。
characters.pose_en: Decisive estate administrator, not a wicked queen archetype.
characters.pose_zh: 果断的庄园管理者，不套用邪恶女王形象。

characters.design_en: White sun vestments, muted gold stitching, old prayer book, official seal; upright tall silhouette.
characters.design_zh: 白色日纹祭服、暗金刺绣、旧祈祷书、官印；高直剪影。
characters.pose_en: Earnest expression, ceremonial restraint; no sinister eyes or demonic elements.
characters.pose_zh: 诚恳神情、仪式性克制，不用邪眼或恶魔元素。

characters.design_en: Squared steel armour, navy mantle, command pennant, practical blade. A training sword is a separate story prop.
characters.design_zh: 方正钢甲、海军蓝披风、指挥旗、实用佩剑；练习剑是独立故事道具。
characters.pose_en: Disciplined, austere veteran; strong horizontal shoulders.
characters.pose_zh: 严肃守纪的老兵，横向肩部剪影鲜明。

characters.design_en: Dark burgundy and charcoal official robes, thin regency insignia, seal case and neatly tied papers.
characters.design_zh: 暗酒红与炭灰官服，细摄政徽记、印盒、整齐捆扎的文书。
characters.pose_en: Polite, composed bureaucrat; no crown, armour, or theatrical evil.
characters.pose_zh: 礼貌镇定的文官；不戴王冠、不穿甲、不做戏剧化邪恶造型。
